$source: Written by scripts/tune-base.mjs from app/tokens.css and docs/design-system/tokens.json. Do not edit.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Lightest surface: inputs, modals, popovers, and the frosted panel over art. Text on it is ink-900 or ink-700.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background: warm paper on Paper, a deep navy night sky on Night (v3.4 lifted it halfway from v3.3's near-black toward the 0d navy). Body text is ink-700.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards and pale tinted panels, a step lighter than their section on Night. Text on it is ink-900 or ink-700; ink-500 at 14px and up.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: Section bands for page rhythm (1f): a step lighter than the page on Paper, a step darker on Night, alternating with the page tone down a long page; the footer sits on it. Text as on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-hero
tokens.usage: The hero ground under the art wash: the page color on Paper, a step lighter on Night so Jane's ink wash shows through at a normal blend (1f). Also the color of the nav fade (.at-hero-top). Text sits on a panel.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Sumi ink. Headlines and primary text. On Night it resolves to warm paper.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Body text. 10.8:1 on Paper surface-100, 12.8:1 on Night.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, credits, timestamps. 5.3:1 on Paper surface-100, 8.2:1 on Night (7.1:1 on surface-000). Never below 14px.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, card borders, dividers. Never readable text.

tokens.name: cobalt-600
tokens.usage: Van Gogh's night blue, the interactive color: links, secondary and tertiary buttons, active nav, selected states, and the primary button on Night. The primary button on Paper is deep plum (button-primary); everything else clickable is cobalt, and nothing that is not clickable is cobalt. 7.7:1 on Paper, 10.4:1 on Night (the pale swirl blue).

tokens.name: cobalt-400
tokens.usage: Hover on cobalt-600 fills and the 2px focus ring (3.9:1 on Paper).

tokens.name: cobalt-100
tokens.usage: Tints: selected rows, KeyChip backgrounds, pale info panels. Text on it is cobalt-600 or ink-900.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cobalt-600 fill.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Star gold. Decorative on Paper (stars, dividers, the pull-quote rule). On Night it is the highlight: the logo, the italic accent line of a headline, the crescent; clearer and more yellow in v3.3 (#dab255). 9.1:1 on Night surface-100; never text on Paper.

tokens.name: gold-300
tokens.usage: Light gold for the crescent and stars on night grounds and dark lockups. Decorative.

tokens.name: plum-700
tokens.usage: Rich plum, the highlight on Paper: the italic accent line of a headline, Dawa's quote marks, highlighted words, the selected tag, and the primary button's hover. 9.5:1 on Paper. On Night it resolves to a light plum for highlighted text (9.0:1); the headline accent on Night uses gold. Clickable only as the primary button's hover on Paper.

tokens.name: plum-fill
tokens.usage: Plum as a fill: a highlight badge, a member tag, the text-selection color. Text on it is on-plum.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text on a plum fill. 10.2:1 on Paper, 7.4:1 on Night.

tokens.name: button-primary
tokens.usage: The primary button's fill (Sep 25): the logo's deep plum on Paper, pale cobalt on Night. Primary buttons only, one per view. A plum Night button (#8a4a8d) is an option for Dawa (open 16).

tokens.name: button-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on the primary button.

tokens.name: on-button-primary
tokens.usage: Text on the primary button. 12.2:1 on Paper's deep plum, 8.9:1 on Night's pale cobalt.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The headline accent: the italic second line and single highlighted words. Rich plum on Paper, star gold on Night.

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: The logo's tone (Sep 24): deep plum on Paper (11.4:1 on surface-100, 12.2:1 on surface-000), star gold on Night. Darker than plum-700 so the mark reads as ink with a plum cast. The logo only; never text or fills.

tokens.name: ember-500
tokens.usage: Ember, from the moon's halo. Eyebrow category labels, stamps, live marks, error text. One strong use per screen. 5.3:1 on Paper surface-100.

tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Deep night band: the emphasis card (like Grove's dark band), dark lockups, the scrim under sky images. Text on it is on-night. On Night it takes an ink-200 hairline, since it sits close to surface-band.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night-900 bands in either mood. 13.7:1 on Paper's band, 16.9:1 on Night's.

tokens.name: on-night-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night-900 bands. 8.9:1.

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: Element accent for Aries, Leo, Sagittarius. Badges and tallies only.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Element accent for Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn. Badges and tallies only.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: Element accent for Gemini, Libra, Aquarius. Badges and tallies only.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Element accent for Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces, a village teal. Badges and tallies only.

tokens.name: on-element
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an element fill, at least 5:1.
